name: What are common signs that my deck needs structural repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my deck needs structural repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs your deck needs structural repair include noticeable swaying or instability, cracked or rotting wood members, loose railings, or widespread fastener corrosion. Checking for visible sagging in the deck surface or beams is also crucial. These issues often indicate that the integrity of the deck's load-bearing components may be compromised, requiring professional assessment to prevent further damage or safety hazards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for swaying, cracked or rotting wood, loose railings, or sagging. These signs suggest compromised structural integrity.
